theme: Eyes and ears: Look vs See, Hear vs Listen...

pages.title: Look vs See
pages.intro: Both are about using your eyes.

pages.title: Miss the boat
pages.meaning: to lose a chance by being too slow
examples: Apply now or you'll miss the boat.
He missed the boat on that deal.

pages.title: Take after
pages.meaning: to look or behave like an older relative

pages.title: A blessing in disguise
pages.meaning: something bad that turns out to be good
examples: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.
The delay was a blessing in disguise.
tip: Idiom: bad at first -> good later
